required_facts.fact: 18 plots at three sites over one winter growing cycle
Median reported yield difference was +6% versus reference plots
Plot differences ranged from -3% to +14%; 12 were positive and six were not
Plots were not randomly assigned and crop mix and baseline conditions differed between sites
Installation cost and energy use were not measured
The steering group can authorize another measurement cycle; wider installation is not approved

disallowed_claims: The pilot proves the intervention will work across the cooperative.
Wider installation is justified by the yield result alone.
acceptable_choices: An asymmetric composition may emphasize the cautious pilot finding while keeping design limits and unmeasured costs visible.
A simple summary with a small plot of the range is acceptable if the finding and qualification remain clearly associated.
The supported next step is another measurement cycle that also records installation cost and energy use; the brief does not require a particular design.
